description: Projet d'éolienne refusé, en cours d'instruction ou réalisé en Charente is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Point object materializing a wind turbine (electric generator equipped with a propeller, operated by the wind, and fixed on a mast) or its project on the department of Charente. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map visualisation service (WMS) of the dataset: Project of wind turbine refused, under investigation or realized in Char" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.3.0, WMS 1.1.1. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2021-11-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
